detail: build_facts_xbrl.py period_label() collapses all instant (balance-sheet) XBRL facts whose 'end' date falls in a calendar year onto a single 'FY{year}' key, with no quarter distinction. For a company mid-fiscal-year (PINS FY=Dec), this means Q1-2026 (end=2026-03-31) and Q2-2026 (end=2026-06-30) balance-sheet snapshots collide on the same 'FY2026' key. The rank tie-break (form=10-K, filed, -pref) is per-concept, so different concepts within the same synthetic 'FY2026' row can win from DIFFERENT quarter-end dates -- e.g. PINS StockholdersEquity landed as the 2026-03-31 value (2850.584M) while CashAndCashEquivalents/Assets/Liabilities landed as the 2026-06-30 value in the same row, producinng an internally inconsistent balance sheet. Only affects the newest, not-yet-fiscal-year-end quarter of each company (prior years get overwritten cleanly once the 10-K is filed and FY{year} becomes the true annual snapshot). Needs quarter-end-aware instant-fact labeling (e.g. label instant facts by the same Q/H1 rule as duration facts, using the fact's own 'end' month, not a bare FY{year}).
example: PINS Q2-2026: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json StockholdersEquity end=2026-03-31 val=2850584000 vs Assets/Liabilities/Cash end=2026-06-30

detail: build_facts_xbrl.py CONCEPTS dict has no 'total_debt' key at all, so total_debt is NULL for every XBRL-path ticker unconditionally, not just when the filer has no debt. PINS issued its first debt (0.00% Convertible Senior Notes) in Q2-2026, tagged as 'ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent' (2026-06-30: 981,128 thousand USD). Needs a 'total_debt' entry in CONCEPTS, e.g. concepts=['DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount','LongTermDebtNoncurrent','ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent','LongTermDebt','ShortTermBorrowings'], merged the same way as other concepts (a company may need current+noncurrent summed rather than picked, unlike the existing single-concept fields).
example: PINS Q2-2026: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent end=2026-06-30 val=981128000

detail: Follow-up to the earlier PINS period_unclear log: this is not just a 2026 edge case. build_facts_xbrl.py period_label() returns bare 'FY{year}' for EVERY instant (balance-sheet) fact regardless of quarter, so ALL quarter-end balance sheets except the one that happens to win the per-concept rank tie-break are silently dropped from core_metrics -- across the company's entire history, not just the newest quarter. For PINS, raw XBRL has StockholdersEquity (and presumably Assets/Liabilities/Cash) at every quarter-end from 2016-12-31 through 2026-06-30 (verified: 35 distinct instant dates), but core_metrics only ever had one populated shareholders_equity value per calendar year, and non-Dec-31 quarters (Q1/Q2/Q3, H1) got NULL balance-sheet columns entirely. Recommended fix: label instant facts the same way as duration facts (Q1/Q2/Q3/H1/FY by the fact's own 'end' month), not a bare FY{year}, so every quarter's balance sheet lands in its own row.
example: PINS: state/xbrl_cache/CIK0001506293.json StockholdersEquity has instant facts at every quarter-end 2016-12-31..2026-06-30, but core_metrics.shareholders_equity is NULL for every period except FY* and H1-2018 was similarly empty pre-fix

build_facts_xbrl.py's 'later filing wins' split-adjustment logic (see collect() docstring) only rescues periods that get RE-REPORTED as comparatives in a later filing. Netflix's 10-K/10-Q only carries 2-3 years of comparatives, so FY2013-FY2022 EPS/shares (7:1-split-adjusted but pre-10:1) and FY2007-FY2013-filed pre-2015 data (pre-7:1) never get a later restated value and stayed on stale share-count bases. Had to rebuild the whole EPS/shares series in this run using the fact's own 'filed' date: filed >= 2026-01-23 (first post-10:1 10-K) is correct as-is; filed before that always needs x10; and filed before 2015-07-15 (pre-7:1 split) needs a further x7 (x70 total, disambiguated by magnitude, not date, since a single filing carries multiple eras of comparatives).

Standalone Q4 duration facts stop existing in XBRL for NFLX after FY2020 (period_label()'s 9-month-YTD 10-Q branch returns None, so Q4 alone is never tagged). FY2021-FY2025 Q4 rows had to be derived as FY-minus-H1-minus-Q3 for flow metrics; EPS for those derived quarters is only an approximation (net_income / FY weighted-avg-diluted-shares), since weighted-average share counts are not additive across quarters. Consider adding FY-minus-YTD derivation as a fallback in build_facts_xbrl.py for any filer with H1+FY but no Q4.

detail: CCC.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2025.txt is misdownloaded/mislabeled: its content (and the source PDF, CCC.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2025.pdf) is actually the H1-2026 announcement (6 months ended 30-Sept-2025, dated 28-Nov-2025) -- a byte-for-byte-similar duplicate of CCC.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt. Separately, ALL of CCC.NZ's HalfYear_H1-YYYY filenames use the CALENDAR year of the September period-end, not the periods.py fiscal-year-of-period convention (FYE 31-Mar) -- e.g. H1-2024.txt covers 6mo to 30-Sept-2024, which is H1 of FY2025, not FY2024. Every H1 file for this ticker needed relabeling by +1 fiscal year when writing core_metrics. Re-download the correct H1-2025 PDF (6mo to Sept-2024) from NZX/AQSE to fill the gap if a standalone one is needed; otherwise the H1-2024.txt comparative column is the only source.

detail: CCC.NZ_AnnualReport_FY2024.txt: pdftotext drops the current-year (FY2024) column in the 3-column balance sheet table (31-Mar-2024 / 31-Mar-2023 Restated / 1-Apr-2022 Restated), so the Total Assets/Liabilities/Net Assets lines silently show only 2 of 3 values and the visible 'Net Assets 761' is actually a misaligned fragment, not FY2024's real -4,001. Pre-FY2021 CCC.NZ half-year/annual prelim announcements (CCC.NZ_Annual_FY2018/19/20.txt, CCC.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2019.txt) only print a single 'Net cash flow from investing activities' total in the abbreviated cash-flow summary -- there is no separate 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' line to extract, so CapEx cannot be recovered for these periods even though a net-investing total exists. Full statutory cash-flow statements (with the PP&E line) only start appearing from FY2021 onward.

Several CMO.NZ annual PDFs (FY2021-2023) and PDF templates have overlapping/duplicated text layers that pdftotext -layout garbles into unreadable interleaved characters (two-column bleed), while pdftotext -raw (no layout preservation) extracts them cleanly. build_facts.py currently only ever runs pdftotext -layout; for this filer -raw is strictly better and should be tried as a fallback pass when -layout output for a page has very low alnum density or repeated stale boilerplate (e.g. a stuck 'For the year to 30 June 2013' header repeating across an FY2022/2023 filing).

CMO.NZ half-year PDF filenames do not reliably encode the true fiscal half. Confirmed via each PDF's own 'first half of the YYYY financial year' text: H1-2020.pdf/H1-2021.pdf/H1-2022.pdf are each one fiscal year off (their content is actually H1-2021/H1-2022/H1-2023 per the FY-ends-June convention). H1-2018.pdf and H1-2019.pdf are byte-identical duplicates (both = Dec-2018 = true H1-2019); true H1-2018 (Dec-2017) was never downloaded, only its comparative column survives inside H1-2019's report. Likewise H1-2023.pdf and H1-2024.pdf are identical content (both = Dec-2023 = true H1-2024); true H1-2023 (Dec-2022) was recovered from H1-2021.pdf's OWN content (which is actually Dec-2022) once the off-by-one was corrected. Any facts-table period derived purely from filename for this ticker needs re-verification against the in-document 'For the six months ended' / 'first half of the ... financial year' text.
example: CMO.NZ_HalfYear_H1-2021.pdf (content is Dec-2021, self-described as '2021/22 financial year' = FY2022)

detail: FY2024, FY2025, H1-2025, H1-2026 annual/interim filings for FSF.NZ are Fund-only accounts with no Fonterra Group balance sheet; only a rounded non-GAAP 'adjusted net debt' figure appears in Chair Report prose (e.g. 'Fonterra's net debt at year-end was $2.6 billion'), which is NOT the same basis as reported borrowings-less-cash used elsewhere in this series. Left TotalDebt/CashAndEquivalents/ShareholdersEquity/TotalAssets NULL for these 4 periods rather than mixing a non-GAAP adjusted-net-debt figure into a GAAP balance-sheet column; recorded the adjusted net debt figures in kpis instead.

Fonterra's 'shares_outstanding' for DCF purposes should be total Co-operative shares on issue (~1.6 billion, disclosed in Note 5 'Subscribed equity instruments' of the interim reports), NOT the Fund's own unit count (107.4 million units, disclosed separately). The Fund units are an economic-rights claim over a subset of the ~1.6bn co-op shares (via the Custodian), not additional shares outstanding. Recorded Fund unit count separately in kpis as FundUnitsOnIssue to avoid future confusion.

detail: Bank filings report a combined 'Deposits' + 'Other borrowings' pair on the balance sheet (Note 15/8/9 depending on year). build_facts.py's TotalDebt candidates pick up Total assets/Total liabilities/other unrelated big numbers instead of the 'Other borrowings' line specifically, which is the correct non-deposit debt figure for a bank holding co. Needed a manual grep for '^Other borrowings' every period; no candidate in facts.TotalDebt was usable as-is.

facts.EPS candidates are all footnote reference numbers (the 'Note 10' / 'Note 6' / 'Note 7' column), not the actual cents value that follows on the same line (e.g. '10   12c   13c' extracted EPS=10 instead of 12). Every EPS value for HGH.NZ had to be re-read from context and reconstructed by hand.
example: HGH.NZ_Annual_FY2020.txt:3461 ('Basic earnings per share  10  12c  13c' -> facts stored 10.0)

detail: Extractor captures the note-reference number (e.g. '19', '20', '5') printed immediately before 'Basic and diluted loss per share' as the EPS value, instead of the dollar figure that follows (e.g. line 'Basic and diluted loss per share 19 $ (0.10) $ (0.09)' yields candidate 19.0, not -0.10). Half-year filings have no note number prefix so 0 EPS candidates were extracted for any H1 period at all.

Several 'statement_line' SBC candidates are actually the cumulative balance-sheet 'Share-based payment reserve' (a running total across years), not the annual P&L/cash-flow SBC expense -- e.g. FY2025 candidate 3959 is the reserve balance; the correct annual expense (943) is the 'Share-based payment expense' line in the operating cash-flow reconciliation note.
example: IKE.NZ_Annual_FY2025.txt:282 vs the correct line in IKE.NZ_Annual_FY2026.txt:3093

detail: No CapEx candidates extracted at all across 17 filings. The cash flow statement splits capex into two separate lines ('Purchases of property, plant, and equipment' and 'Additions to intangible assets') that are never summed or matched individually by any CapEx pattern.

FY2026 filing's own 'Adjusted EBITDA' reconciliation table prints an 'EBITDA' result row of (11,362) that is actually FY2025's EBITDA carried over from the prior filing (verified: -16336+102+1+1928+3124-181 = -11362, matching FY2025's OWN filing which independently states FY2025 EBITDA=-11,362). FY2026's true EBITDA (computed from its own inputs: -7581+74+0+1651+1275-449) is -5,030, near its Adjusted EBITDA of -5,038. The printed FY2026/FY2025 EBITDA row in the FY2026 filing is column/period-shifted; do not trust it at face value -- recompute from the row's own inputs.

H1-2023, H1-2024 and H1-2026 PDFs downloaded are investor presentations / media releases only (rounded ~$0.1m figures, no balance sheet, no shares outstanding), not the full condensed interim financial statements NZX-listed companies also file. core_metrics for these 3 periods therefore only has Revenue/GrossProfit/NetIncome at reduced precision and no ShareholdersEquity/SharesOutstanding/CashAndEquivalents/TotalDebt. Consider re-downloading the actual half-year report PDF for these periods.

Balance sheet splits liquid cash across 'Cash and cash equivalents' and a separate 'Term Deposit' (+accrued interest) line in FY2024-26 and H1-2021..H1-2026 filings; the extractor only captures the 'Cash and cash equivalents' line, understating true liquid cash by the term-deposit amount (e.g. H1-2022: cash line 43,957 vs term deposit 2,011,696). FY2019/FY2020 filings do NOT split them (term deposits already folded into the single cash line), so the pattern is period-dependent within the same entity.

FY2024 annual's Statement of Changes in Equity has 'Loss for the year - (812,259) (812,259)' but the extractor's statement_line match returned 0.0 for both equity-statement occurrences (line 196, 205); the correct value was only recoverable from the P&L's 'Net loss' line (also present but not picked as statement_line either -- had to read Extracted/IPR.NZ_Annual_FY2024.txt directly at line 130).

facts.units_hint says 'thousands' for this ticker but the filings are headed plain '$' (whole NZD) throughout FY2019-FY2026 -- confirmed from Statement of Financial Position headers and cross-checked against a 514.9m-share company with a ~NZ$1.5m market cap (issued capital 5,672,856 total, not billions).
